articles.summary: TriNet, a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small and medium-size businesses (SMBs), today announced a suite of human-centered, AI-powered capabilities designed to deliver intelligent and responsive HR support with privacy and security controls.
articles.title: TriNet to Launch AI-Powered Suite of Offerings to Empower SMBs with Personalized, Data-Driven HR Support

articles.summary: TriNet, a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small and medium-size businesses (SMBs), today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025.
articles.title: TriNet Announces Third Quarter 2025 Results & Reaffirms Full Year 2025 Guidance

articles.summary: In addition to its third quarter 2025 earnings results today, TriNet, a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small and medium-size businesses (SMBs), announced that Mala Murthy will join the company as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective November 28.
articles.title: TriNet Appoints Mala Murthy as Chief Financial Officer, Succeeding Kelly Tuminelli
